Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. Lizelle Lee and Laura Wolvaardt are the openers for South Africa Women. Katherine Brunt to start with the ball.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! 294 runs for South Africa Women to win and make history. South Africa have never made it to the World Cup finals and they have a chance here. It will be hard but they have the firepower in them. An exciting chase coming up.

Sana Mir is standing near the pitch. She says there are a little bit of footmarks, the pitch is not going to change a lot. Mentions that England will need to bowl on a good length, and the target is very good on this pitch.

Danni Wyatt, the player of the moment, says that she is very pleased and they have great a score on the board, and she hopes the bowlers do well and defend the score now. Mentions that the wicket was good and she wanted to capitalize on the width, but she was playing her game. States that there have been a few good catches also, but it feels good when there are a few drop catches while batting. Concludes by saying that they have a good total, but still, there is a lot of work to do, the bowlers need to bowl well and bowl in the right area.

South Africa have themselves to blame for! After choosing to bowl first, they did not make the most of the movement available early on and then the misfields and drop chances made it even harder for them. Five of the drop catches were of Wyatt, who went on to score a century so South Africa will be disappointed with their fielding mostly. They did well to take wickets at regular intervals but failed to control the middle phase. Not a good performance but they have a chance to redeem themselves by showing their class with the bat. Shabnim Ismail was again the star as she took three wickets while Kapp and Klaas came in handy with two wickets each.

A superb innings from England! They were off to a slow start and were losing wickets at regular intervals but Danni Wyatt made sure she makes full use of the opportunity she was given. She was dropped five times at different stages of the game. Wyatt did well to put small stands with Natalie Sciver and Jones before Sophia Dunkley came and then both notched up a partnership of 116. It was much needed at that point as England were losing wickets regularly. Once Wyatt fell, Dunkley took the charge and scored a half-century and in the end, Sophie Ecclestone's 24 off just 11 balls could prove to be the difference between the two teams. England will be confident to defend this out as they have a good bowling attack as well.

OUT! TIMBER! Shabnim Ismail starts the over with a wicket and ends with a wicket! She gets her third wicket! A slower ball, on a length, around off. Sophie Ecclestone makes room and tries to go over cover. But she misses it completely due to lack of pace and the ball goes on and hits the top of off. England Women end at 293/8!
Very full, around middle. Sophie Ecclestone looks to heave this, but she gets an inside edge back onto her pads.

FOUR! Make that three in a row! A slower ball, full, on middle. Sophie Ecclestone lifts it over the bowler's head and the ball races away to the boundary. Sophie Ecclestone is guiding England Women to a huge total here!
FOUR! Another boundary! Short ball again, around middle. Sophie Ecclestone looks to pull this but the ball goes off the top edge over the keeper for a boundary.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! A shorter ball, angling down leg. Sophie Ecclestone pulls it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Kate Cross walks out.

OUT! CAUGHT! A fine knock from Sophia Dunkley comes to an end! Shabnim Ismail strikes and gets her second wicket of the game. On a length this time, around off. Sophia Dunkley looks to smash this over mid on, but the ball goes off the outer half of the bat and flies high towards mid off. Lizelle Lee there takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Lizelle Lee b Shabnim Ismail

Commentary.Commentary: Slower ball, around middle, on a length. Sophia Dunkley sweeps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Sophia Dunkley drives it towards extra cover.
On a length, outside off. Sophia Dunkley looks to swing this but she misses.
FOUR! Wow! Wonderful shot! Very full on this occasion, on middle. Sophia Dunkley gets low, gets under the bounce and smashes it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another low full toss, around middle. Sophie Ecclestone sweeps it towards short fine leg. Marizanne Kapp dives to her left and makes a good stop. Single taken!
A low full toss, on middle. Sophia Dunkley sweeps it towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Fuller ball, slower, down the leg side. Sophie Ecclestone sweeps it towards fine leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Top shot! A timely boundary! Very full again, on middle. Sophie Ecclestone drills it straight down the ground for a boundary.
Very full on this occasion, around middle. Sophia Dunkley smashes it straight down the ground. The ball deflects off the stumps at the bowler's end and goes towards mid off. Single taken!
Another length delivery, around middle. Sophie Ecclestone works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good fielding there! A length ball, around middle. Sophia Dunkley works it away wide of long on. Chloe Tryon runs to her left and makes a good stop. One run!
On a length, around middle. Sophie Ecclestone pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tad shorter, around middle. Sophie Ecclestone pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Sophie Ecclestone comes in.

OUT! TIMBER! What a delivery by Masabata Klaas. Top stuff! She grabs her second wicket and England Women lose their sixth wicket now. Masabata Klaas serves a length ball, very slow on this occasion, around off. Katherine Brunt goes for the pull, but she is way too early in her shot and was beaten by lack of pace. She misses and the ball goes on to clip the top of off. She walks back to the hut.
On a length, around middle. Sophia Dunkley nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Slower ball, fuller ball, around off. Katherine Brunt pushes it towards long off for a single.
Good running! On a length, around middle, slower ball. Katherine Brunt works it away towards mid-wicket and takes two runs.
Shorter ball, around middle. Sophia Dunkley pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Marizanne Kapp drops it short now, around middle. Katherine Brunt pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. A fumble there by the fielder allows the batters to complete the second run easily.
FOUR! Crunched! Full again, outside off. Katherine Brunt drives it powerfully through cover for a cracking boundary. She gets off the mark in style!
Fuller, outside off. Katherine Brunt drives it towards cover.
On a length, around middle. Katherine Brunt defends it out.

On a length, outside off. Sophia Dunkley pushes it towards mid off for a single. Fifty for Sophia Dunkley! It's been a top knock from her! She will want to stick around till the 50th over to guide England Women to a healthier total.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Sophia Dunkley punches it towards sweeper cover. Shabnim Ismail runs to her left and stops the ball. Two taken. She moves on to 49 now!
Length and on off, pushed back to Klaas.
Four byes! A length ball, slanting on leg. Brunt swings across the line and misses. The ball bounces over the leg pole and escapes the keeper to find the fence.
Angled on the pads, flicked to square leg for a single.
Length ball, slanting on off. Blocked out.
Katherine Brunt comes to the crease now.

OUT! Up in the air and finally the catch is taken! What an innings this is by Danni Wyatt, might be the winning one for England! Appreciation all around as she walks back now. Coming onto the ball - This was on a length and outside off. Wyatt has only one thing on mind, to go big but she splices this one to point where Lizelle Lee runs back and to her right to take a fine catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Lizelle Lee b Masabata Klaas

Commentary.Commentary: This is full and was dipping onto the batter, outside off. Wyatt misses her sweep.
Length again, outside off. Wyatt strokes it to deep point for a single.
Length and on off, Dunkley works it to covers for a single.

Short of a length, angling on middle. Dunkley mistimes her pull and it goes to deep square leg. Masabata Klaas runs to her left and dives but the ball was swirling in the wind, so she did well to eventually stop the boundary. Two runs taken.
Shorter in length and on leg. Dunkley ducks under it.
A slower ball, full and outside off. Dunkley slams it to mid off.
Short ball, outside off. Wyatt hooks it but it goes off the top edge and drops in front of the deep square leg fielder. A single taken.
In the blockhole, this is hit to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Too full and on off, Dunkley drives it to long off for a single.
Wide! A length ball, angling on the pads. Dunkley steps down and misses her flick.
Very full and going down. Wyatt makes room and sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Fuller again, on off. Wyatt hits it to the right of long off and comes back for the second easily.
FOUR! Good shot! A full ball, outside off. Wyatt muscles it well over covers for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, eased down to long on for a single.
Full ball, down the leg side. Wyatt misses her sweep. She wants a wide but the umpire thinks there is something on it.
Length ball, around middle and leg. Dunkley tucks it on the fine leg for a single. A 100-run stand between these two. Superb partnership!
Short in length, on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Dunkley cuts it to deep point for a single.
Short of a length, angling on middle. Dunkley gets low to pull but takes her eyes of it and gets hit on the helmet. It was off the gloves though.
Full and on middle, pushed to mid on.
A length ball, down the leg side. Wyatt misses her sweep and the keeper does well to take it to her left.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Full and outside off. Dunkley hammers it uppishly and to the right of covers where the fielder dives and stops it. Will count as another drop though.
DROPPED! How many more? A length ball, on middle. Wyatt pulls it to deep mid-wicket where Shabnim Ismail is standing. She has an easy catch but juggles and drops it in the end. Single taken!
A length ball, on middle. Dunkley bunts it to square leg for a single.
Marizanne Kapp drops it short now, around middle. Danni Wyatt pulls it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Another pitched up delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt drives it past cover. Two taken!
Slower ball, full, outside off. Sophia Dunkley drives it through cover for a single.
Pitches it up, outside off. Danni Wyatt gets low and drives it towards sweeper cover. That was a terrific shot, but there is protection in the deep. Single taken!
On a length, outside off. Danni Wyatt slices it uppishly towards third man. The fielder does well to keep the ball away from the boundary ropes. Two taken!
Very full, wide of off this time. Danni Wyatt opens the face of her bat and tries to guides this towards third man but she misses.
Wide! Marizanne Kapp drops it short now, around middle. Danni Wyatt ducks under it. Wide called for height!
Shortish delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Down the leg side, slower through the air, fuller ball. Sophia Dunkley sweeps it towards deep square leg for single.
Full toss, around middle. Sophia Dunkley pushes it towards mid on and rotates the strike.
Back of a length, outside off. Danni Wyatt punches it off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a single.
Tad fuller now, outside off. Sophia Dunkley looks to drive this but the ball goes off the top edge towards third man. Single taken!
Shorter ball, outside off. Danni Wyatt pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Low full toss, around middle. Danni Wyatt knocks it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller ball, outside off. Danni Wyatt drives it uppishly over mid off for a boundary. 200 up for South Africa Women!
Another playa and a miss! A similar delivery. Length and outside off. Danni Wyatt once again tries to cut this off the back foot but fails to get any bat on it.
Swing a miss! Tad slower on this occasion, on a length, outside off. Danni Wyatt stays in her crease and tries to cut this away but she misses.
On a length again, outside off. Danni Wyatt slashes it uppishly towards mid off. The fielder there collects the ball on the bounce. No run taken!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Sophia Dunkley steers it towards third man for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Sophia Dunkley cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single. She retains the strike.
Five Wides! Fuller ball, down the leg side. Sophia Dunkley looks to sweep this but she misses, the keeper fails to grab the ball as well and it races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Fuller now, around off. Danni Wyatt pushes it towards point for another single.
Tad shorter, outside off. Sophia Dunkley taps it towards cover for a single.

There it is! Tad fuller, outside off. Danni Wyatt pushes it towards cover-point and scampers through to the other end for a single. Century for Danni Wyatt! Her second One Day hundred and her first in the World cup! She has stepped up on the right occasion. It's been a great knock so far!
Another short ball, outside off. Danni Wyatt cuts it towards point. No run taken!
Shorter ball, spinning away, around off. Sophia Dunkley pushes it toward cover for a single.
Another fuller delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt looks to sweep this, but gets an inside edge back onto her arm and the ball falls near her boot.
Fuller delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt drives and finds the fielder at cover.
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! A shorter ball, around middle. Danni Wyatt pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary. She moves on to 99 now!
Angling in, on a length, around the thigh pads. Sophia Dunkley tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller ball, wide of off. Sophia Dunkley leans to drive but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man. Two taken!
On a length, around middle. Sophia Dunkley presents the full face of her bat and defends it out.
Wide! Fuller ball, down the leg side. Sophia Dunkley leaves it alone. Wide given!
FOUR! Wyatt making most of the opportunity! Short and on middle. She pulls it in the gap to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball, slower and on off. Blocked out.
Length and outside off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! A low dipping full toss, on middle. Wyatt backs away and flat bats it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary. A loosener and Wyatt moves into the 90s! The 50-run stand is up as well.
Around off, eased down to long on for a single.
Full and on the pads, Dunkley plays it with the angle to square leg.
Ayabonga Khaka (6-0-34-1) comes back to bowl.
Full ball, slower and outside off. Wyatt smashes it hard to short cover where the fielder catches it. It felt like it went on the way but it did not carry.
On a length, on middle, Dunkley nudges it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Slower ball, outside off, it is hit to deep cover for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Dunkley comes down the track and pushes it to mid off for a run.
Length ball, around middle. Wyatt pulls it low to deep square leg for a single.
On the pads, this is flicked to short fine leg.
FOUR! Timely boundary! A full ball, slanting on middle. Dunkley gets low and sweeps it to fine leg for a boundary.
Around off, it is punched to covers for a single.
Again keeps it tight, on middle. Dunkley makes room and drops it to point for a single.
Short again but this time angling on off. Dunkley gets cramped for room as she knocks it to covers.
Short and outside off. Wyatt cuts it to point where the fielder dives to her right and stops it. A single.
Flatter and on the pads, tucked to square leg.
A maiden for Klaas, first one of the innings! A length ball, outside off. Dunkley misses her cut.
Length ball, on off. Dunkley looks to work it to the leg side but gets a top edge to covers.
Length and on off. Blocked out.
Slightly short and on off. Dunkley rocks back and keeps it out on the leg side.
Fuller ball, angling around off. Dunkley works it to mid off.
Flatter and on off. Dunkley defends it out.
Around off, pushed through covers for a couple of runs now.

FOUR! Chance! Too short and on off. Wyatt goes back and pulls to deep mid-wicket where Lara Goodall fumbles and lets it through her hands for a boundary. Danni Wyatt is living a charmed life there in the middle.
Shorter and outside off, cut away to deep cover for a single.
Tad short and on off. Wyatt slaps it to covers for another single.
Full and on off, pushed to long off for a single.
Very full and on leg. Wyatt plays it back to the bowler who deflects away to mid off for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Sophia Dunkley shows the full face of her bat and blocks it out solidly.
Wide! Very short this time, around middle and leg. Sophia Dunkley ducks underneath it and leaves it alone. Wide has been called for height!
Back of a length, around off. Sophia Dunkley defends it off the back foot.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt guides it through point for a single.
On a length, darting it on the pads. Sophia Dunkley flicks it past square leg for a single.
A shorter ball this time, outside off. Sophia Dunkley leans back and leaves it alone.
Pitched up delivery, around off. Sophia Dunkley drives it towards mid off.

Drinks! England Women are just keeping the run rate in check. It is Danni Wyatt who is anchoring the role till now and small partnerships along the way is helping England roll through. South Africa need wickets at regular intervals to keep the pressure on.
Shorter ball, outside off. Sophia Dunkley punches it through cover. Single taken! She retains the strike as well.
Fuller ball this time, on middle. Sophia Dunkley steps down and pushes it back to the bowler.
Another back-of-a-length delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt slaps it towards sweeper cover for another single.
Shorter ball, width on offer. Sophia Dunkley pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Slower through the air, full, around middle. Sophia Dunkley blocks it out.
Loopy delivery, fuller length, outside off. Sophia Dunkley drives it past cover for a brace.
Fuller delivery, on middle. Sophia Dunkley knocks it down toowards mid on and takes a single.
FOUR! Pulled away! Shorter ball, around middle. Sophia Dunkley picks up the length early and smashes it past square leg for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, around middle. Sophia Dunkley blocks it out solidly.
On a length, outside off. Danni Wyatt cuts it towards point for single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Danni Wyatt drives it towards cover.
Fuller in length, down the leg side. Danni Wyatt tucks it towards fine leg. Masabata Klaas there fumbles a bit and the batters complete two runs comfortably.
Fullish delivery, around middle. Sophia Dunkley steps down and pushes it towards mid on.
FOUR! Top shot! Shorter ball, outside off. Sophia Dunkley punches this off the back foot past cover for a boundary.
Wide! Down the leg side, fuller ball. Sophia Dunkley looks to sweep but she misses. Wide called!
Shorter ball, outside off. Sophia Dunkley punches it towards cover.
Tad fuller, outside off. Sophia Dunkley shuffles across and paddle scoops it towards fine leg. Two taken!
In the air...and over! A shorter ball, around off. Danni Wyatt lifts it just over the bowler's head for a single.
Shorter ball, width on offer. Danni Wyatt pushes it towards point.
Chloe Tryon is back into the attack.
Another fuller length delivery, outside off. Sophia Dunkley once again drives it towards cover.
Fuller ball, outside off. Sophia Dunkley drives it towards cover.
Sophia Dunkley comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Marizanne Kapp has broken this partnership as she gets rid of Amy Jones. She was looking well settled at the crease and this is a big wicket for South Africa Women. This was a length delivery, darting it around the pads. Amy Jones looks to flick this away on the leg side, but the ball goes off the leading edge towards mid-wicket. Chloe Tryon runs back, dives, and takes a stunning catch. England Women lose their fourth wicket and Marizanne Kapp grabs her second wicket of the game.
Commentary.Howout: c Chloe Tryon b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt pushes it towards cover and takes a single.
Shorter ball, around off. Danni Wyatt pulls it towards deep square leg for a brace.
On a length, around middle. Danni Wyatt lifts it over the fielder at mid on. The ball will not race away but the batters pick up two runs.
A length ball, outside off. Wyatt smashes it over point. Mignon du Preez runs from deep cover and does ever so well to save a run for her team. Superb commitment from her.
Angles a full ball, on middle. Wyatt smashes it straight down to long on. The mid on fielder chases it and does well to dive near the ropes and keep it down to two.
Again this is wide outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.
A full ball, outside off. Jones steps down and lofts it to deep cover for a couple of runs. A controlled shot.
Length and just outside off. Jones taps it to covers.
Full ball, outside off, pushed to mid off.
Full ball, outside off. Wyatt plays it to covers.
Very full and on off. Danni keeps it out.
Again width on offer. Jones hits it to sweeper cover for a single.
A length ball, angling outside off. Jones guides it to pont.
FOUR! Width given, outside off and this was on a fuller length. Jones drives it hard and through covers for a boundary.
Length, slower and on off. Jones works it to mid-wicket.
Angles it on middle, this is flicked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Fullish and targeting the off stump. Jones drills it to mid-wicket.
A length ball, outside off. Jones shuffles across and whacks it to the vacant deep mid-wicket region for a couple of runs.
Outside off, Jones drives it but straight to the cover fielder.
On a length and outside off. Jones strides forward and knocks it to cover.
A widish yorker, outside off. Wyatt digs it out to short third man for a single.
Masabata Klaas (3-0-24-0) comes back into the attack.

FOUR! Boundary to start the over and to end the over as well. A length ball, outside off. Jones looks to push it but gets a thick outside edge past the keeper who is standing up at the stumps and to the third man fence.
Slower one on middle, this time Jones pushes it to mid on.
Around off, on a length, Amy pushes it to covers.
On a length and on off. Jones dead bats it to covers.
Length and slanting on middle, tucked to square leg.
FOUR! A full ball, outside off. Jones waits and then caresses it through covers for a boundary. Much needed and that brings up 100 up for England.
Flatter and on off. Jones punches off the back foot to long off for a run.
Shorter and outside off, cut away to deep point for a single.
Another tossed up delivery, full, around middle. Danni Wyatt tries to sweep this, but the ball gos off the top edge and over the fielder at mid on. Two taken!
Loopy delivery, full, around off. Amy Jones steps down and drives it towards mid off for a single.
On middle. Blocked out.
A full toss angling on leg. Jones pulls it to deep square leg and Shabnim Ismail does well to dive to her right and stop it. Two runs taken.
Back of a length, outside off. Amy Jones pushes it towards deep point for a single. She retains the strike!
Fullish delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt drives it past cover for a single.
Full in length again, outside off. Danni Wyatt drives and finds the fielder at cover this time.
Fuller ball, around middle. Danni Wyatt steps down the pitch and looks to heave this, but she gets an inside edge back onto her pads.
Another length delivery, on the pads. Amy Jones flicks it through square leg and takes a single.
On a length, angling in, around middle. Amy Jones defends it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Amy Jones punches it towards cover for a single.
Full now, outside off. Danni Wyatt once again scoops this towards fine leg. The ball will not race away to the boundary. But the batters pick up three runs.
Shorter ball, outside off. Danni Wyatt pushes it towards cover.

Fuller, sower through the air, around off. Danni Wyatt shuffles across, gets down on her knee and scoops it towards fine leg for a brace. 50 for Danni Wyatt! That is her second fifty of the tournament.
Shorter, outside off. Amy Jones pushes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Tosses it up, full, on middle. Amy Jones pushes it towards mid on.
Shabnim Ismail drops it short again, around middle and leg. Danni Wyatt ducks under it. A successful over from Shabnim Ismail!
Another back-of-a-length delivery, around middle. Amy Jones pulls it towards deep square leg and takes a single.
On a length, around middle. Amy Jones defends it out.
Fraction shorter, outside off. Danni Wyatt dabs it towards third man for a single.
Shabnim Ismail drops it short again, around middle. Danni Wyatt ducks underneath it and leaves it alone.
Amy Jones walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shabnim Ismail comes back into the attack and strikes straightaway! Natalie Sciver departs for a timid score and England Women lose their third wicket. A shorter ball, around middle. Natalie Sciver hangs back and pulls this, but the ball goes off the top edge and flies high towards square leg. Marizanne Kapp runs back across and this time she pouches it safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Marizanne Kapp b Shabnim Ismail

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller now, around middle. Natalie Sciver looks to flick this, but she gets a leading edge just away from the fielder at cover. Single taken!
Fraction shorter again, outside off. Danni Wyatt cuts it towards point and takes a single.
Tad shorter now, outside off. Natalie Sciver pushes it past cover-point for a single.
Slower through the air, loopy delivery, full, outside off. Natalie Sciver drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Much fuller now, outside off. Danni Wyatt drives it towards cover and takes a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Danni Wyatt walks across and paddle scoops this towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Fuller now, around middle. Natalie Sciver pushes it back to the bowler.
On a length, outside off. Natalie Sciver chops it towards point.
Fullish delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt taps it towards cover and rotates the strike.
Very full, around middle. Danni Wyatt looks to block this but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a brace.
Good-length delivery, wide of off. Danni Wyatt cuts it towards the fielder at point.
On a length, outside off. Natalie Sciver pushes it towards cover for a single.
On the pads. Danni tickles it to fine leg for a brace.
Slightly short and outside off, cut away to deep cover for a run.
Slower through the air, around off. Sciver lunges and defends it out.
Full ball, angling on middle. Sciver flicks it wide of deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Length ball, outside off, width there. Sciver slaps it to point this time.
Tossed up, length and outside off. Sciver plays it to backward point.
Outside off, on a length. Sciver cuts it late to third man for one more.
Time for some spin! Chloe Tryon comes into the attack.
Wide! Length ball, outside off, over the tramline. Left alone.
Length ball, outside off. Sciver hangs back and wrists it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid on.
FOUR! Short ball, outside off. Sciver pulls it with full control, to deep square leg for a boundary.
Length and outside off. Wyatt prods and strokes it to point for a quick single.
A slower length ball, outside off. Sciver looks to push it but gets an inside edge to square leg for a single.
Very full and swinging back in around off. Wyatt looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On middle, flicked through square leg for a single.

DRINKS! South Africa Women have done well to bounce back after two drop chances. They have grabbed on two wickets now and will want to capitalize on the same. Danni Wyatt is looking good solid at the crease at the moment, but she also has some luck favoring her, since she has been dropped twice. She will want to build a partnership with Natalie Sciver who has just walked out to bat replacing Heather Knight.

OUT! LBW! A huge appeal for LBW but not given and South Africa takes it upstairs. Looked very close. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows three reds and finally, South Africa gets the breakthrough. A length ball, around off, it lands and nips back in sharply. Knight looks to work it on the leg side but misses and gets hit on the pads. Luus thinks twice before taking it upstairs and this time the decision is in her favor.
Outside off, driven nicely but straight to point.
Fuller ball, outside off. Knight misses her drive.
A length ball, on off, pushed through covers for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Wyatt guides it to third man for a single.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.

Dropped! South Africa Women are not taking their chances! On a length and on off, extra bounce. Wyatt looks to pull but mistimes it completely. The ball lobs and goes to mid-wicket where Marizanne Kapp tries to take in front of her but fails to catch it. Was not that hard though.
Full and straying on middle. Wyatt whips it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Superb shot! This is full and outside off. Wyatt steps down and smashes it over covers for a boundary. She looks in good touch.
Tad fuller and on middle. Wyatt blocks it out.
Too full and outside off. Wyatt drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Continues to get the shape, around off, pushed to covers.
Fullish balll, swinging back in on middle. Wyatt plays across to mid-wicket.
Slants it on the pads. Wyatt nudges it to square leg.
Fuller and swinging back around off. Wyatt defends it out.
Angles a full ball, on middle, tucked to mid-wicket.
End of Powerplay 1. Now, South Africa can field a maximum of 4 fielders outside the circle till the 40th over.
Another length delivery, around middle. Heather Knight pushes it back to the bowler. 9 runs off Masabata Klaas' first over!
Length delivery, around off. Heather Knight defends it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Danni Wyatt dabs it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Good-length delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt drives it past cover-point for a boundary.
Fuller ball, outside off. Danni Wyatt drives it towards cover.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Masabata Klaas creates an opportunity on her very first delivery! A length ball, shaping away, outside off. Danni Wyatt leans and tries to drive this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards first slip. Lizelle Lee dives to her left, gets her hand to the ball, but fails to grab it. The ball races away towards third man for a boundary.
Outside off, tad shorter. Heather Knight taps it towards point.

Good-length delivery, angling in around middle. Heather Knight looks to block this one, but she misses as the ball nips back in and hits her on the pads. South Africa Women appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no and they go up for the review. No bat involved, confirms UlraEdge. Ball Tracker shows the impact was outside. The on-field decision stands. South Africa Women lose a review!
Back of a length, outside off. Danni Wyatt pushes it towards point off the back foot for a single.
Wide! Length ball, way wide of off. Danni Wyatt leaves it alone. Wide given!
On a length, outside off. Danni Wyatt guides it towards third man for a brace.
FOUR! And again! This was a replica of the previous delivery! Tad shorter again, wide of off. Danni Wyatt once again walks across and cuts it past point for another boundary.
FOUR! Cut away! Ayabonga Khaka begins with a shorter ball, wide of off. Danni Wyatt walks across and slashes it past point for a boundary.
Fraction shorter, outside off. Danni Wyatt pushes it towards cover off the back foot for a single.
Make that five! Length delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt slashes it towards point.
Fullish delivery, outside off. Danni Wyatt drives it towards cover. Four dots in the over so far.
Good-length delivery, on the pads. Danni Wyatt tries to flick this but the ball goes off her gloves onto the deck.
On a length this time, outside off. Danni Wyatt hangs back and pushes it towards backward point.
Marizanne Kapp pitches it up, around off. Danni Wyatt advances down the pitch and drives it towards cover.
Fuller this time, angling in on the pads. Heather Knight flicks it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Back of a length, width on offer. Danni Wyatt chops it towards deep backward point for a single.
Tad shorter, outside off. Danni Wyatt pushes it towards point. No run there!
FOUR! She gets it in the gap this time! Tad shorter, wide of off this time. Danni Wyatt slashes it past the diving point fielder for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off. Danni Wyatt hangs back and cuts it towards point and finds the fielder once again.
Fraction shorter, outside off. Danni Wyatt stays in her crease and cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Wide! Fuller in length, down the leg side. Danni Wyatt leaves it alone. Wide called!
Pitches it up again, outside off. Heather Knight leans and pushes it towards mid off. Just 1 off the over!
Tad fuller now, outside off again. Heather Knight leans forward, opens the face of her bat, and taps it towards point.
Shaping away, outside off and on a length. Heather Knight lunges forward and lets that go through.
Outside off, on a length. Heather Knight presses forward and defends it out.
On a length once again, outside off. Heather Knight leaves it alone.
Good-length delivery, darting it on the thigh pads. Danni Wyatt tucks it towards square leg and takes a single.
Length ball, on off. Wyatt knocks it in front of covers and takes off for a single.
Length, outside off. Wyatt chops it to point.
Wide! Short ball, on middle. Wyatt sits under it. A wide given for the height.
On a length, outside off. Wyatt keeps it out on the off side.
Short of a length, outside off. Knight hits it to deep point for a run.
Fuller and slanting around off. Knight defends with her bat and pad together. Probing line and length.
A length ball, outside off. Wyatt cuts it uppishly and to deep point. A bit of fumble there but still the batters take only a single.
On a length, outside off. Knight offers no shot.
Wide! Length and angling down the leg side. Knight misses her flick.
Keeps it outside off, on a length. Knight square drives it to point.
Outside off. Left alone.
Length ball, outside off, moving away. Knight shoulders arms to it.
Heather Knight, the skipper of England Women, comes out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Marizanne Kapp was the star when these two sides met in the league stage match and she is the one who gives the breakthrough here. This is on a length and outside off, hint of away swing with some extra bounce. Beaumont takes a step forward as she looks to push this, but only gets an outside edge to the keeper, Trisha Chetty who takes it comfortably. Good start for South Africa Women.
Commentary.Howout: c Trisha Chetty b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, around off. Beaumont works it on the leg side.
Shorter in length and on middle, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
On a length, on off. Blocked out.

A huge appeal for LBW but not given! A length ball, angling around middle and leg. Beaumont leans and looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. Might be going down. The replay shows it was going onto hit the leg pole on umpire's call.
Length ball, outside off. Beaumont pushes with gentle hands to point. No run there.
Full again, outside off, played back to the bowler.
Very full and slanting on the off pole. Beaumont squeezes it out to point.
Length and outside off. Wyatt drops it to covers.
Fuller ball, outside off. Wyatt steps across and mistimes her push to mid-wicket.
Full, going away outside off. Wyatt slashes at it but misses.
Short of a length, outside off, extra bounce this time. Beaumont looks to punch it but it takes the shoulder of the bat and lobs over the slip cordon for a single.
Short of a length, outside off, cut away through point for a single.
Hint of away shape there, on a length and outside off. Wyatt guides it to point.
Wide! A length ball, outside off, shaping away. Wyatt leaves it alone.
Marizanne Kapp will bowl from the other end. Two slips in place.
Short ball, on off. Beaumont looks to pull but is late on her shot and she gets hit on the helmet. The ball balloons and drops around the corner on the off side. A concussion test to follow...
This one comes with the angle, on a length and on off. Blocked out.
Wyatt is off the mark as well! On a length, outside off, not much movement at the moment and Wyatt steers it to third man for a run.
Short of a length, angling outside off. Beaumont dabs it late to third man for a single.
Full again, around off. Beaumont pushes it to covers this time.
FOUR! What a start! Overpitchedand outside off. Beaumont leans and smashes it through covers for a boundary. Tammy Beaumont and South Africa Women are underway!

We are ready for action! The players have made their way out to the middle. All the players will take the knee in support of the BLM movement first. Tammy Beaumont and Danni Wyatt will open the batting for England Women. Shabnim Ismail will begin the proceedings with the new ball. Here we go...

The game is set to begin. Both the teams stride out to the middle and are lined-up for their respective national anthems. First, the national anthem of England will be played followed by South Africa's.

PITCH REPORT - Anjum Chopra and Sana Mir are near the pitch. Anjum Chopra says the conditions are windy and overcast. Sana Mir says that this is the pitch on which England and Pakistan had played in the league stage and this time its a more brownish pitch. Adds that it will be slower as compared to last time when there was grass around. Mentions that there will be early help for the bowlers.

Heather Knight the skipper of England Women says they would have bowled as well. Adds it is the same pitch as they played against Pakistan and they have to bat well here. Tells that the pressure is always there and it is a great opportunity to lead this team. Informs that there is one change, Anya Shrubsole is back in the side.

Sune Luus the skipper of South Africa Women, says they are going to bowl first, it's a fresh wicket and it will be good to see how things go upfront. Mentions that it was a great game against India, but today is a new game and they are looking forward. Adds that they are extremely proud of what they have done so far, and they going will be satisfied going back home with their performance.

England Women (Playing XI) - Tammy Beaumont, Danni Wyatt, Heather Knight (C), Natalie Sciver, Amy Jones (WK), Sophia Dunkley, Katherine Brunt, Sophie Ecclestone, Kate Cross, Charlotte Dean, Anya Shrubsole (In for Freya Davies).

South Africa Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Lizelle Lee, Laura Wolvaardt, Lara Goodall, Sune Luus (C), Mignon du Preez, Marizanne Kapp, Chloe Tryon, Trisha Chetty (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Masabata Klaas, Ayabonga Khaka.
TOSS - South Africa Women have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

England Women had a disappointing start to the tournament with three losses on the trot but they found their groove against India and since then they have won four back-to-back games and have managed to seal a semi-final spot. England Women were beaten by South Africa Women earlier in this tournament, but things are different now since England have found their rhythm and they look to carry on the same way. So both the teams are riding high on confidence. The match-up cannot get any better, who do you think will win? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.

South Africa Women were a bit underrated coming into this tournament, but the way they have played against some of the best teams needs more appreciation. They finished the league stage in the second position with just one defeat and their last group match was an absolute thriller against India Women and they just managed to come on top. They are riding high on confidence after their league stage games and have all the momentum with them. South Africa Women have never crossed the penultimate hurdle and have a great chance but it's not going to be easy since they are up against a tough side. This game does take you back to the 2017 World Cup semi-final, where the same two teams were up against each other and England Women had come out on top. But South Africa Women look much stronger now and they will want to come out on top this time.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second semi-final of the ICC Women’s World Cup where South Africa Women will take on England Women and will fight for the final destination. Australia are already through but who will join them, the defending champions England or South Africa? We will find out soon.
